label: D2 after choosing a2, when the previous trial was rewarded (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (99.9% of mass) and only when the GO choice was a2 (in_action == 2; never after a1). Needs a rewarded previous trial (in_rew at that D1 == 1; 98% of mass). Also depends strongly on position in the episode: high on trials ~3-50, falling off by 60 and silent after trial 70 and on trials 0-2. This looks like a slow drift in the hidden state, not a task variable. Magnitude is largest when a2 led to the rare state S1 (state == 1 alone: precision 0.76 but recall only 0.37). It is also higher in long rewarded a2 streaks while S2 is good. It does not fire at D1 or GO, after a1, or after an unrewarded previous trial. All variables are observable at D2. Within the predicate, precision is about 0.6: many eligible steps stay silent, so something in the hidden state also gates it.
